    Scope
    Ordinary direct PvE Active damage only. Schema 2 continues a complete snapshot through immunity, shield or Puncture handling, retained-HP conversion, incoming-damage limits, death resistance and HP subtraction. A sequence carries only HP and Block between hits and requires stable target tags/states with intervening effects assumed absent. Target selection, callbacks, statistics, death execution, Card Awake, state-trigger-add and unsupported formula modes remain outside this adapter. Output stays Experimental until a frozen prediction passes independent gameplay verification.
    

    Local unpublished research preview. The included example uses synthetic values to demonstrate the contract and is not a build recommendation or gameplay observation.
